thread:
Aisha (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today’s all-hands about the org adjustments and hiring plan. I’ll try to answer live here.

Priya (People Ops): Can you share the high-level headcount delta and timeline? People asked in AM all-hands.

Aisha (CEO): Short answer: net +28 FTEs over the next 3 quarters, focused on infra, platform, and ML infra. We’re phasing hires to preserve runway and prioritize production reliability.

Liam (Finance): To add numbers: Q2 +10, Q3 +10, Q4 +8 (hiring contingent on revenue performance). We’ll publish an updated hiring calendar later today.

Devon (Engineering Manager): Which teams specifically get the +28? Is this redistributed from other groups or net new?

Aisha (CEO): Mostly net new. Priorities: Eng-Platform (+12), Eng-Runtime (+8), Eng-ML infra (+5), Product (+3). Sales/Marketing are near flat this cycle; we’re keeping ops tight there.

Emma (Platform TL): Any guidance on IC vs manager ratio? We’re concerned about manager overload as teams grow.

Priya (People Ops): We’re aiming for 8–10 ICs per manager. If teams breach that, we’ll recruit for one dep TL/manager role. Promotions and new manager hires are in scope.

Matt (Head of Product): For product hiring, are we prioritizing PMs for infra features or product-facing PMs?

Aisha (CEO): Prioritize PMs who can work across infra and customer-facing product (hybrid). We need people who can translate performance SLOs into product requirements.

Devon (Engineering Manager): What about contractors and agency vendors we currently use — any conversion plan?

Priya (People Ops): We’ll convert critical long-term contractors where it makes sense; others may be evaluated case-by-case. Conversion windows will be open Q2–Q3.

Liam (Finance): Budget note: conversions reduce short-term contractor spend but increase headcount OTE — accounted for in the Q2/Q3 numbers.

Emma (Platform TL): Any change to hiring regions or remote-first policy? We have candidates in APAC pipeline.

Aisha (CEO): Remote-first remains. We’ll continue hiring in NA/EU/APAC with priorities based on team needs and compliance. No forced relocations.

Priya (People Ops): We’ll post an updated org map and hiring tracker in #people-ops by EOD. Also: FAQs about comp bands and interview loops will be attached.

Devon (Engineering Manager): Will there be role-level job descriptions for the new infra openings? Helps managers triage candidates.

Priya (People Ops): Yes — standardized JD templates + hiring scorecards. Template link will be in the tracker.

Aisha (CEO): Quick note on reorganizing: this is not a headcount reduction — it’s re-alignment to focus on reliability and throughput. We’ll keep teams informed about reporting changes. Managers should schedule 1:1s to walk teams through impacts.

Matt (Head of Product): About reporting changes — will any product squads be merged or split?

Aisha (CEO): A couple of small splits in Product (infra-facing vs integrations) to reduce cognitive load. We’ll share a proposed map tomorrow and take feedback for 48 hours.

Emma (Platform TL): TL;DR for managers: hiring priorities, conversion windows, org map + calendar = publish today. Managers to run 1:1s and nominate candidates for conversion.

Priya (People Ops): Confirmed. Action items in #people-ops: 1) Org map + hiring tracker (EOD). 2) JD templates + scorecards (EOD). 3) Conversion process doc (by next Monday).

OncallBot: Incident digest: none reported in the last hour.

Devon (Engineering Manager): Thanks — will schedule team sync. Appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:

Aisha (CEO): Thanks all. If you have private questions, DM me or Priya. We’ll update the doc and loop back with managers after feedback window.
